source.license: date-holidays: ISC code; shipped holiday data notice CC BY-SA 3.0 (package metadata differs). city-timezones: MIT. UK snapshot: OGL-UK-3.0 with attribution. IANA/ICU and CLDR data retain upstream notices.
source.cost: Offline runtime; no API key, subscription or per-call API charge. Optional weekly government calendar drift check is a public read.
source.rate_limits: No runtime upstream requests. Input, date span, tool-list and result bounds enforced locally; the weekly calendar check has a 10-second deadline and 1 MiB cap.

incumbent.selection_reason: The strongest relevant executable option in the reviewed set by overlap with dated conversion, calendar arithmetic and business-day workflows. Its 17 native tools cover substantially more of this corpus than the official two-tool time reference, the narrower Go time utilities, or the holiday/business-only server. Selected by relevant coverage, not its zero-star popularity. It launches unmodified from an immutable commit with explicit compatible dependency and interpreter pins. All 17 tools remain enabled; this corpus excludes its financial-market features. Agent-level performance and superiority remain unproven.

candidates.scope: Current time and current-date HH:MM conversion; no dated conversion or calendar/business tools. Retain as an official secondary reference.
